 .exp22-character{width:91px!important;}
 .exp23-experiment .stage-scene .visual-frame{width:calc(100% - 10px)!important;}
}
@media(max-width:390px){
 .stage-viewport.exp23-experiment .stage-command-panel .mission-actions{gap:8px!important;}
 .stage-viewport.exp23-experiment .stage-command-panel .mission-actions .btn{min-width:0!important;padding:8px 4px!important;font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.25!important;}

}
@media(max-width:350px){
 .exp23-world-chip{top:41%;left:48%;padding:6px 8px;}

 .exp22-character{width:85px!important;}
 .exp22-apparatus .exp22-sigil{width:52px!important;height:52px!important;}
 .exp22-note{display:none;}
}

 .exp23-embers,.exp22-character .exp22-figure,.exp22-character.walking .exp22-figure,
 .exp22-character .exp23-leg,.exp22-character .exp23-arm,.exp22-character .exp23-cloak,
 .exp22-character.walking:after,.exp22-character.walking .exp22-shadow,.exp23-exploring .exp22-interact{animation:none!important;}

<style id="clockwork-v024-style">
/* v0.24. The world machine follows the actual s01 controls; clock hands/gears only start after a stage success. */
body[data-scene="world"] .stage-viewport.exp22-enabled .exp22-world{overflow:visible;}
.exp24-mechanism{position:absolute;left:76%;bottom:calc(31% + 61px);width:clamp(164px,15vw,250px);height:auto;aspect-ratio:220 / 256;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:1;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(1px 12px 12px #000a) drop-shadow(0 0 24px #e3c78e17);opacity:.84;transition:filter .7s,opacity .7s;}
.exp24-clock-svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;}
.exp24-mechanism:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:26%;top:7%;width:48%;height:42%;border-radius:50%;background:#eecb824a;filter:blur(26px);opacity:.22;transition:opacity .8s;}
.exp24-mechanism .exp24-clockface{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px #f6d69f58);}
.exp24-mechanism .exp24-gears{opacity:.9;}
.exp24-mechanism[data-powered="true"]{opacity:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 16px #000a) drop-shadow(0 0 24px #83fbd286);}
.exp24-mechanism[data-powered="true"]:before{opacity:.9;background:#8dffe899;}
.exp24-mechanism[data-powered="true"] [data-exp24-beam]{opacity:1;}
.exp24-mechanism[data-powered="false"] [data-exp24-beam]{opacity:.21;}
.exp24-mechanism[data-waking="true"]{animation:exp24-engine-wake 1.65s both;}
@keyframes exp24-engine-wake{0%{filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 14px #000a);transform:translateX(-50%) scale(.98)}28%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 45px #ffefd7) drop-shadow(0 0 80px #91f0d9);transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1.035)}100%{transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1)}}
.exp24-machine-label{position:absolute;bottom:-9px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid #cdb68388;border-radius:9px;padding:5px 11px;color:#fce4a5;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0c2635eF,#101522eF);font:700 10px/1.35 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.035em;box-shadow:0 7px 14px #000a;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #000;}
.exp24-machine-label span{font-size:11px;color:#c0d8db;font-weight:600;}
.exp24-mechanism[data-powered="true"] .exp24-machine-label{border-color:#aff9d2aa;color:#c6ffe6;}
.exp24-mechanism[data-powered="true"] .exp24-machine-label span{color:#fff1c6;}
.exp24-victory{position:absolute;left:50%;top:clamp(245px,30%,300px);width:min(88%,415px);transform:translate(-50%,-14px);z-index:30;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#052f3bf0,#11383ae9 65%,#4b4635f0);border:1px solid #c9f2d9dd;color:#fff6d1;padding:14px 17px;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 14px 50px #000c,0 0 28px #65f9d54d;transition:opacity .45s,transform .45s,visibility 0s .45s;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);}
.exp24-victory.show{visibility:visible;opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translate(-50%,0);transition:opacity .45s,transform .45s;}
.exp24-victory strong{display:block;flex:1 0 100%;font-size:clamp(15px,2vw,21px);letter-spacing:.05em;text-shadow:0 0 15px #82efce80;}
.exp24-victory p{margin:0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#d5efee;}
.exp24-victory button{border:1px solid #fff5c1;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#f9e3a2,#debd71);color:#0b2830;min-height:43px;min-width:135px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}
.exp24-victory button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #94f8de;outline-offset:3px;}
.exp24-mechanism[data-powered="true"] + .exp22-character .exp23-hand-lamp{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px #dbfff8);}
/* Put the machine behind the adventurer and align the existing interaction beacon with its base. */
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-world>.exp22-character{z-index:3;}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-world>.exp22-apparatus{z-index:4;}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp24-mechanism{z-index:2;}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp24-victory{z-index:24;}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp24-mechanism[data-powered="true"] ~ .exp23-world-chip{border-color:#88f2c3;box-shadow:0 0 27px #92f3d041;}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp24-mechanism[data-waking="true"] ~ .exp22-character .exp23-arm-front{animation:exp24-hero-cheer .7s ease-in-out 2;}
@keyframes exp24-hero-cheer{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}50%{transform:rotate(-21deg)}}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .exp24-mechanism{width:clamp(137px,40vw,170px);bottom:calc(36% + 61px);} 
 .exp23-world-chip{display:none!important;} /* Decorative chip competes with the actual in-world clock on small screens. */
 .exp22-apparatus span:last-child{display:none!important;} /* Device is visually recognizable; the button retains its aria-label. */
 .exp24-machine-label{font-size:9px;bottom:-12px;padding:4px 7px;}
 .exp24-machine-label span{font-size:9px;}
 .exp24-victory{top:clamp(213px,26%,260px);padding:10px 11px;gap:6px;}
 .exp24-victory strong{font-size:15px;}.exp24-victory p{font-size:11px;}
 .exp24-victory button{font-size:12px;min-height:40px;}
}
@media(max-width:360px){.exp24-mechanism{width:133px;bottom:calc(39% + 63px)}.exp24-machine-label{font-size:8px;padding:3px 6px}.exp24-victory{top:230px;width:93%;}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.exp24-mechanism[data-waking="true"],.exp24-mechanism[data-waking="true"] ~ .exp22-character .exp23-arm-front{animation:none!important}.exp24-victory{transition:none!important}}
</style>
<script id="clockwork-v024-script">
(()=>{'use strict';
/* Progressive enhancement: installs only for stage s01. The existing evaluator, sliders, saves and HUD are never replaced. */
const app=document.getElementById('app');if(!app)return;
const markup='<svg class="exp24-clock-svg" viewBox="0 0 220 256" aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> <defs>   <linearGradient id="exp24-bronze" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#ffedbb"/><stop offset=".32" stop-color="#ab884e"/><stop offset=".65" stop-color="#564937"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#d9b874"/></linearGradient>   <linearGradient id="exp24-steel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#87a9af"/><stop offset=".47" stop-color="#172e3c"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#758e9f"/></linearGradient>   <radialGradient id="exp24-face"><stop stop-color="#122d37"/><stop offset=".75" stop-color="#071623"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#223c40"/></radialGradient>   <radialGradient id="exp24-glow"><stop stop-color="#c6fff0" stop-opacity=".8"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#85eac4" stop-opacity=".28"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#85eac4" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>   <filter id="exp24-soft"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="6"/></filter> </defs> <ellipse cx="110" cy="248" rx="69" ry="7" fill="#000c"/> <path d="M35 44Q30 15 58 11H162Q190 11 185 44L177 162Q167 180 144 188H72Q48 181 42 162Z" fill="#081826c9" stroke="#e1c08078" stroke-width="4"/> <path d="M54 33Q106 21 166 33L155 153H64Z" fill="url(#exp24-steel)" stroke="#f5dd9f66" stroke-width="2" opacity=".78"/> <g class="exp24-gears">   <g data-exp24-gear="a" transform="translate(70 85)"><polygon points="0.0,-29.0 4.8,-36.3 9.5,-35.4 11.1,-26.8 14.5,-25.1 22.3,-29.1 25.9,-25.9 23.0,-17.7 25.1,-14.5 33.8,-14.0 35.4,-9.5 28.8,-3.8 29.0,0.0 36.3,4.8 35.4,9.5 26.8,11.1 25.1,14.5 29.1,22.3 25.9,25.9 17.7,23.0 14.5,25.1 14.0,33.8 9.5,35.4 3.8,28.8 0.0,29.0 -4.8,36.3 -9.5,35.4 -11.1,26.8 -14.5,25.1 -22.3,29.1 -25.9,25.9 -23.0,17.7 -25.1,14.5 -33.8,14.0 -35.4,9.5 -28.8,3.8 -29.0,0.0 -36.3,-4.8 -35.4,-9.5 -26.8,-11.1 -25.1,-14.5 -29.1,-22.3 -25.9,-25.9 -17.7,-23.0 -14.5,-25.1 -14.0,-33.8 -9.5,-35.4 -3.8,-28.8" fill="url(#exp24-bronze)" stroke="#f4ddae" stroke-width="2"/><circle r="22" fill="#061b27" stroke="#d9b477" stroke-width="2.5"/><path d="M-16 0H16 M0-16V16 M-11-11L11 11 M-11 11L11-11" stroke="#d7b37d" stroke-width="4"/><circle r="6" fill="#f3e2a8"/></g>   <g data-exp24-gear="b" transform="translate(144 102)"><polygon points="0.0,-24.6 4.4,-30.8 8.8,-29.8 10.2,-22.4 13.3,-20.7 20.4,-23.5 23.5,-20.4 20.7,-13.3 22.4,-10.2 29.8,-8.8 30.8,-4.4 24.6,0.0 24.4,3.5 29.8,8.8 28.3,12.9 20.7,13.3 18.6,16.1 20.4,23.5 16.8,26.1 10.2,22.4 6.9,23.6 4.4,30.8 0.0,31.1 -3.5,24.4 -6.9,23.6 -12.9,28.3 -16.8,26.1 -16.1,18.6 -18.6,16.1 -26.1,16.8 -28.3,12.9 -23.6,6.9 -24.4,3.5 -31.1,0.0 -30.8,-4.4 -23.6,-6.9 -22.4,-10.2 -26.1,-16.8 -23.5,-20.4 -16.1,-18.6 -13.3,-20.7 -12.9,-28.3 -8.8,-29.8 -3.5,-24.4" fill="url(#exp24-bronze)" stroke="#f3ddae" stroke-width="2"/><circle r="18" fill="#061b27" stroke="#d9b477" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M-13 0H13 M0-13V13 M-9-9L9 9 M-9 9L9-9" stroke="#d7b37d" stroke-width="3.5"/><circle r="6" fill="#f3e2a8"/></g> </g> <g class="exp24-clockface"><circle cx="109" cy="62" r="39" fill="url(#exp24-face)" stroke="#e8c78e" stroke-width="5"/><circle cx="109" cy="62" r="34" fill="none" stroke="#80979a" stroke-width="1.5"/> <path d="M109 31V39 M109 85V92 M78 62H86 M132 62H140" stroke="#f6e0ab" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/> <g data-exp24-hand="hour" transform="rotate(-38 109 62)"><path d="M109 66V44" stroke="#f2d9a7" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/></g> <g data-exp24-hand="minute" transform="rotate(25 109 62)"><path d="M109 70V34" stroke="#e9ffef" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></g><circle cx="109" cy="62" r="6" fill="#f0deaa"/> </g> <path d="M109 113v16" stroke="#eac887" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/> <g data-exp24-swing transform="rotate(0 109 128)">  <path d="M109 128V218" stroke="#13252a" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>  <path d="M109 128V218" stroke="#f1d08f" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>  <circle cx="109" cy="221" r="23" fill="url(#exp24-bronze)" stroke="#ffe3ac" stroke-width="3"/>  <circle cx="104" cy="216" r="9" fill="#faebb3" opacity=".65"/>  <circle data-exp24-beam cx="109" cy="221" r="41" fill="url(#exp24-glow)"/> </g> <g data-exp24-sparks opacity="0"><path d="M109 5V21 M76 19L88 30 M143 20L132 31 M182 59H167 M51 59H35" stroke="#d8ffef" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/></g> <path d="M49 178h20 M149 178h20" stroke="#efcf88" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/> </svg>';
let view=null, engine=null, win=null, wasComplete=false, wasStageDone=false, angleA=0, angleB=0, elapsed=0, last=0, lastRead=-1000, phaseStart=-1, resetTimer=0;
const reduced=()=>window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const active=()=>{try{return document.body.dataset.scene==='world'&&state.view==='world'&&state.sid==='s01'}catch(_){return false}};
const el=(parent,selector)=>parent?.querySelector(selector);
const isComplete=()=>{try{return Boolean(state.progress&&state.progress.s01)}catch(_){return false}};
const hasJustWon=()=>{try{return !!state.stageDoneNow}catch(_){return false}};
const periodSeconds=()=>{try{return Number(period(state.pValues.length,state.pValues.amp))||1}catch(_){return 1}};
function install(v){
 if(!v?.querySelector('.exp22-world'))return;
 view=v;angleA=0;angleB=0;elapsed=0;lastRead=-1000;phaseStart=-1;
 const layer=el(view,'.exp22-world');
 const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='exp24-mechanism';box.setAttribute('role','img');box.setAttribute('aria-label','振り子の周期に合わせて揺れる時計塔の模型。歯車はステージクリアで動き出す');box.setAttribute('data-powered',String(isComplete()));
 box.innerHTML=markup+'<div class="exp24-machine-label"><b data-exp24-status>調律待ち</b><span data-exp24-period>周期を測定中</span></div>';
 const beacon=el(layer,'.exp22-apparatus');layer.insertBefore(box,beacon);
 const banner=document.createElement('div');banner.className='exp24-victory';banner.setAttribute('role','status');banner.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');
 banner.innerHTML='<strong>✦ 時計塔が目を覚ました！</strong><p>周期を合わせたことで、止まっていた装置が動き出した。</p><button type="button" data-exp24-back>塔の変化を見に戻る</button>';
 layer.appendChild(banner);
 banner.querySelector('[data-exp24-back]').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  banner.classList.remove('show');
  if(view===v&&v.classList.contains('exp23-experiment'))el(layer,'.exp22-interact')?.click();
 });
 engine=box;win=banner;wasComplete=isComplete();wasStageDone=hasJustWon();
 update(0,0,true);
}
function wake(t){
 phaseStart=t;engine.dataset.waking='true';
 /* The compact in-world victory banner replaces the older floating toast for this stage only. */
 document.querySelectorAll('.fx-toast').forEach(node=>node.remove());
 win.classList.add('show');
 engine.querySelector('[data-exp24-sparks]')?.setAttribute('opacity','1');
 /* Existing completion flow and user opt-in sound remain authoritative. */
 try{app.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('furiko:clockwork-started',{detail:{stage:'s01'}}))}catch(_){}
}
function update(ms,dt,force=false){if(!engine||!view)return;
 const T=Math.max(.2,Math.min(5,periodSeconds()));const complete=isComplete();
 const nowStageDone=hasJustWon();
 if(!wasStageDone&&nowStageDone){wake(ms)}
 wasStageDone=nowStageDone;
 if(complete!==wasComplete){engine.dataset.powered=String(complete);wasComplete=complete}
 const machine=el(view,'.exp22-apparatus');
 if(machine?.style.left)engine.style.left=machine.style.left;
 if(ms-lastRead>150||force){
  const status=el(engine,'[data-exp24-status]'),reading=el(engine,'[data-exp24-period]');
  let err=Math.abs(T-1);
  if(status)status.textContent=complete?'✦ 時計塔 稼働中':err<=.07?'✧ 周期が合った！':'⚙ 周期を調整中';
  if(reading)reading.textContent='1往復 '+T.toFixed(2)+'秒／目標 1.00秒';
  engine.setAttribute('aria-label','振り子の現在の周期'+T.toFixed(2)+'秒。'+(complete?'時計塔は稼働中。':'まだ停止中。'));
  lastRead=ms;
 }
 const swing=el(engine,'[data-exp24-swing]');
 if(swing){const a=reduced()?0:Math.cos(ms/1000*2*Math.PI/T)*Math.min(15,Number(state.pValues.amp)||12);
   swing.setAttribute('transform',`rotate(${a.toFixed(2)} 109 128)`);}
 if(complete){
   // The gears are a completion signal. No mechanical power is attributed to the pendulum itself.
   if(!reduced()){angleA=(angleA+dt*(360/Math.max(2,T*4)))%360;angleB=-(angleA*1.2);}
   el(engine,'[data-exp24-gear="a"]')?.setAttribute('transform',`translate(70 85) rotate(${angleA.toFixed(2)})`);
   el(engine,'[data-exp24-gear="b"]')?.setAttribute('transform',`translate(144 102) rotate(${angleB.toFixed(2)})`);
   if(!reduced()){
     elapsed+=dt;
     el(engine,'[data-exp24-hand="minute"]')?.setAttribute('transform',`rotate(${(25+elapsed*12).toFixed(2)} 109 62)`);
     el(engine,'[data-exp24-hand="hour"]')?.setAttribute('transform',`rotate(${(-38+elapsed).toFixed(2)} 109 62)`);
   }
 }
 if(phaseStart>=0&&ms-phaseStart>1800){engine.dataset.waking='false';el(engine,'[data-exp24-sparks]')?.setAttribute('opacity','0');phaseStart=-1;}
}
function tick(ms){const dt=last?Math.min(.06,(ms-last)/1000):0;last=ms;
 if(active()){
   const v=app.querySelector('.stage-viewport.exp22-enabled');
   if(v&&v!==view)install(v);
   if(engine&&v===view)update(ms,dt);
 }else if(view){view=null;engine=null;win=null;wasStageDone=false;}
 requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}
requestAnimationFrame(tick);
})();
</script>
<style id="hero-actions-v025-style">
/* v0.25: the existing drawn character performs actual actions in response to the stage controls. */
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-character .exp23-arm-front,
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-character .exp23-arm-back{transform-box:view-box;}

 .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="reach"] .exp23-arm-front{animation:exp25-reach .68s ease-out both!important;}

 .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="reach"] .exp23-head{animation:exp25-head-focus .68s ease-out both!important;}
@keyframes exp25-reach{0%{transform:rotate(0deg)}46%{transform:rotate(-57deg)}75%,100%{transform:rotate(-42deg)}}
@keyframes exp25-head-focus{0%{transform:rotate(0)}60%,100%{transform:rotate(6deg) translateY(2px)}}

body[data-scene="world"] .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="tune"] .exp23-arm-back{animation:exp25-tune-back .6s ease-in-out infinite alternate!important;}
@keyframes exp25-tune-arm{from{transform:rotate(-53deg)}to{transform:rotate(-32deg)}}
@keyframes exp25-tune-back{from{transform:rotate(0)}to{transform:rotate(14deg)}}

@keyframes exp25-cast{0%{transform:rotate(-30deg)}22%{transform:rotate(17deg)}55%,85%{transform:rotate(-76deg)}100%{transform:rotate(-34deg)}}
@keyframes exp25-lean{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}50%{transform:rotate(5deg)}}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-character[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp23-arm-front,
body[data-scene="world"] .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp23-arm-front{animation:exp25-cheer-front .6s ease-in-out 3 alternate both!important;}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-character[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp23-arm-back,
body[data-scene="world"] .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp23-arm-back{animation:exp25-cheer-back .6s ease-in-out 3 alternate both!important;}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-character[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp22-figure,
body[data-scene="world"] .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp22-figure{animation:exp25-happy-jump .62s cubic-bezier(.3,0,.25,1) 3!important;}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-character[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp23-cloak,
body[data-scene="world"] .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp23-cloak{animation:exp25-cheer-cape .3s ease-in-out 6 alternate!important;}
@keyframes exp25-cheer-front{0%{transform:rotate(-39deg)}100%{transform:rotate(-115deg)}}
@keyframes exp25-cheer-back{0%{transform:rotate(2deg)}100%{transform:rotate(95deg)}}
@keyframes exp25-happy-jump{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}37%{transform:translateY(-13px)}65%{transform:translateY(-3px)}}
@keyframes exp25-cheer-cape{0%{transform:rotate(-9deg)}100%{transform:rotate(14deg)}}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-character[data-exp25-action="think"] .exp23-head,
body[data-scene="world"] .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="think"] .exp23-head{animation:exp25-think 1.15s ease both!important;}
@keyframes exp25-think{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0deg)}40%,80%{transform:rotate(-9deg) translateY(4px)}}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-character[data-exp25-action="think"] .exp23-arm-front,
body[data-scene="world"] .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="think"] .exp23-arm-front{animation:exp25-think-arm 1.15s ease both!important;}
@keyframes exp25-think-arm{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}50%{transform:rotate(-37deg)}}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-character[data-exp25-action="tune"] .exp23-hand-lamp,
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-character[data-exp25-action="cast"] .exp23-hand-lamp,
body[data-scene="world"] .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="tune"] .exp23-hand-lamp,
body[data-scene="world"] .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="cast"] .exp23-hand-lamp{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #fff0b0) drop-shadow(0 0 6px #a9fff5)}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-character[data-exp25-action="cheer"]:before{content:"✦  ✧   ✦";position:absolute;left:0;top:4%;width:100%;text-align:center;font-size:22px;color:#d9fff1;text-shadow:0 0 14px #b8fff2;animation:exp25-sparkle 1s ease-out 2;pointer-events:none;z-index:3}
@keyframes exp25-sparkle{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.4) translateY(20px)}45%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.15) translateY(-10px)}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.3) translateY(-25px)}}
/* The camera view of the same hero remains visible next to the physics instrument in experiment mode. */
body[data-scene="world"] .exp23-experiment .stage-scene .visual-frame{position:relative!important;}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp23-exploring .exp25-lab-actor{display:none!important;}
.exp25-lab-actor{position:absolute;bottom:3px;left:9px;width:82px;height:125px;z-index:7;pointer-events:none;isolation:isolate;filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 10px #000b);}
.exp25-lab-actor:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:14% -15% 0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 67%,#94fff033,transparent 66%);border-radius:50%;filter:blur(8px);z-index:-1;}
.exp25-lab-actor .exp22-figure{position:absolute;inset:0;}
.exp25-lab-actor svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;}
.exp25-lab-actor .exp23-arm-front{transform-origin:80px 85px;}
.exp25-lab-actor .exp23-arm-back{transform-origin:28px 85px;}
.exp25-lab-actor .exp23-head{transform-origin:55px 68px;}
.exp25-lab-actor .exp23-cloak{transform-origin:52px 79px;}
.exp25-lab-actor .exp23-arm,.exp25-lab-actor .exp23-head,.exp25-lab-actor .exp23-cloak{transform-box:view-box;}
.exp25-lab-actor .exp23-cloak{animation:exp23-cloak-idle 3s ease-in-out infinite;}
.exp25-lab-actor .exp22-figure{animation:exp23-idle 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:50% 100%;}
.exp25-lab-message{position:absolute;bottom:7px;left:89px;z-index:8;pointer-events:none;font-size:10px;font-weight:750;line-height:1.45;max-width:calc(100% - 134px);padding:6px 9px;border-radius:10px;color:#e4fff5;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #000;background:#071928e0;border:1px solid #8dbeb878;box-shadow:0 3px 10px #0009;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;}
.exp25-lab-message[data-exp25-visible="true"]{opacity:1}
.exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="cheer"]:after{content:"✦✧✦";position:absolute;top:-17px;right:-13px;color:#e3ffca;font-size:18px;text-shadow:0 0 8px #c2fff1;animation:exp25-sparkle 1s linear 2;}
/* During the in-world win scene, hide experiment navigation controls that would cover the dialogue. */
body[data-scene="world"] .stage-viewport:has(.exp24-victory.show) .v020-pan-controls,
body[data-scene="world"] .stage-viewport:has(.exp24-victory.show) .v020-direct-panel,
body[data-scene="world"] .stage-viewport:has(.exp24-victory.show) .v021-bob-target{opacity:0!important;visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important;}
body[data-scene="world"] .stage-viewport:has(.exp24-victory.show) .exp25-lab-actor,
body[data-scene="world"] .stage-viewport:has(.exp24-victory.show) .exp25-lab-message{opacity:0!important;}
/* A close-up of the same protagonist stays visible even when the 320px victory overlay hides the lab scene. */
.exp24-victory.exp25-story-victory{display:grid;grid-template-columns:63px minmax(0,1fr);gap:3px 10px;align-items:center;text-align:left;}
.exp24-victory.exp25-story-victory strong{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;flex:none;text-align:left;line-height:1.3;}
.exp24-victory.exp25-story-victory p{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;text-align:left;}
.exp24-victory.exp25-story-victory button{grid-column:2;grid-row:3;min-width:0;width:100%;font-size:12px;}
.exp25-win-actor{grid-column:1;grid-row:1 / 4;width:63px;height:106px;pointer-events:none;align-self:end;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 7px #000b);}
.exp25-win-actor .exp22-figure{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;transform-origin:50% 100%;}
.exp25-win-actor svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;}
.exp25-win-actor .exp23-arm-front{transform-origin:80px 85px;}
.exp25-win-actor .exp23-arm-back{transform-origin:28px 85px;}
.exp25-win-actor .exp23-cloak{transform-origin:52px 79px;}
.exp25-win-actor .exp23-arm,.exp25-win-actor .exp23-cloak{transform-box:view-box;}
.exp25-win-actor[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp23-arm-front{animation:exp25-cheer-front .6s ease-in-out 3 alternate both!important;}
.exp25-win-actor[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp23-arm-back{animation:exp25-cheer-back .6s ease-in-out 3 alternate both!important;}
.exp25-win-actor[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp22-figure{animation:exp25-happy-jump .62s ease 3!important;}
@media(max-width:360px){
 .exp24-victory.exp25-story-victory{top:170px;grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr);gap:2px 7px;padding:8px 10px;}
 .exp24-victory.exp25-story-victory strong{font-size:13px;}
 .exp24-victory.exp25-story-victory p{display:none;}
 .exp24-victory.exp25-story-victory button{min-height:36px;font-size:11px;}
 .exp25-win-actor{width:52px;height:86px;}
}
/* Electrical response is attached to the actual clock tower, not a decorative independent animation. */
.exp24-mechanism .exp25-energy{position:absolute;inset:-13%;border-radius:45%;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 62%,transparent 43%,#9fffe247 55%,transparent 68%);filter:blur(4px);}
.exp22-world[data-exp25-pose="tune"] .exp25-energy{opacity:.9;animation:exp25-energy .5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.exp22-world[data-exp25-pose="cast"] .exp25-energy{opacity:1;animation:exp25-energy .27s ease-in-out 3 alternate}
@keyframes exp25-energy{from{transform:scale(.88);opacity:.2}to{transform:scale(1.1);opacity:1}}
@media(max-width:760px){.exp25-lab-actor{width:67px;height:105px;left:6px;bottom:4px;}.exp25-lab-message{left:69px;max-width:calc(100% - 112px);font-size:9px;padding:5px 7px;bottom:7px;}}
@media(max-width:360px){.exp25-lab-actor{width:56px;height:91px;bottom:8px;left:3px;}.exp25-lab-message{left:57px;max-width:calc(100% - 97px);font-size:9px;}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 .exp22-character[data-exp25-action] .exp23-head,.exp22-character[data-exp25-action] .exp23-arm,
 .exp22-character[data-exp25-action] .exp22-figure,.exp22-character[data-exp25-action] .exp23-cloak,
 .exp25-lab-actor .exp23-head,.exp25-lab-actor .exp23-arm,.exp25-lab-actor .exp22-figure,.exp25-lab-actor .exp23-cloak,
 .exp22-character[data-exp25-action="cheer"]:before,.exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="cheer"]:after,
 .exp24-mechanism .exp25-energy{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;}
 .exp25-win-actor .exp22-figure,.exp25-win-actor .exp23-arm{animation:none!important;}
 .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="reach"] .exp23-arm-front,.exp22-character[data-exp25-action="reach"] .exp23-arm-front{transform:rotate(-40deg)}
 .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="tune"] .exp23-arm-front,.exp22-character[data-exp25-action="tune"] .exp23-arm-front{transform:rotate(-40deg)}
 .exp25-lab-actor[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp23-arm-front,.exp22-character[data-exp25-action="cheer"] .exp23-arm-front{transform:rotate(-95deg)}
}
</style>
<script id="hero-actions-v025-script">
(()=>{'use strict';
const app=document.getElementById('app');if(!app)return;
const active=()=>document.body.dataset.scene==='world'&&state.view==='world'&&state.sid==='s01';
let vp=null,hero=null,lab=null,world=null,tag=null,clock=null,winner=null,poseTimer=0,feedbackTimer=0,opening=false,castTimer=0,lastPhase='';
// Namespaced copy of the established hero artwork (same outfit and facial proportions).
function copyAvatarSvg(el){const copy=el.querySelector('.exp22-figure')?.cloneNode(true);if(!copy)return null;
 for(const node of copy.querySelectorAll('[id]')){const old=node.id,nodeId='exp25-'+old;node.id=nodeId;
  copy.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(n=>{for(const a of Array.from(n.attributes||[])){if(a.value.includes('url(#'+old+')'))n.setAttribute(a.name,a.value.split('url(#'+old+')').join('url(#'+nodeId+')'))}})}
 return copy;}
function mount(next){vp=next;hero=vp?.querySelector('.exp22-character');world=vp?.querySelector('.exp22-world');clock=vp?.querySelector('.exp24-mechanism');lab=null;tag=null;winner=null;opening=false;lastPhase='';clearTimeout(poseTimer);clearTimeout(feedbackTimer);clearTimeout(castTimer);
 if(!world||!hero)return;
 const frame=vp.querySelector('.stage-scene .visual-frame');
 if(frame){const actor=document.createElement('div');actor.className='exp25-lab-actor';actor.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');const figure=copyAvatarSvg(hero);if(figure)actor.appendChild(figure);frame.appendChild(actor);lab=actor;
  const message=document.createElement('span');message.className='exp25-lab-message';message.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');message.textContent='';frame.appendChild(message);tag=message;}
 if(clock){const spark=document.createElement('span');spark.className='exp25-energy';clock.appendChild(spark);}
 mountVictory();setPose('idle',0);
}
function mountVictory(){if(!world||!hero||winner)return;const banner=world.querySelector('.exp24-victory');if(!banner)return;const actor=document.createElement('div');actor.className='exp25-win-actor';actor.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');const figure=copyAvatarSvg(hero);if(figure)actor.appendChild(figure);banner.prepend(actor);banner.classList.add('exp25-story-victory');winner=actor;}
function setPose(action,duration=0){if(!vp||!world||!hero)return;clearTimeout(poseTimer);
 hero.dataset.exp25Action=action;if(lab)lab.dataset.exp25Action=action;if(winner)winner.dataset.exp25Action=action;world.dataset.exp25Pose=action;
 if(duration>0){const node=vp;poseTimer=setTimeout(()=>{if(vp===node)setPose('idle',0)},duration)}
}
function say(message,duration=1800){if(!tag)return;clearTimeout(feedbackTimer);tag.textContent=message;tag.dataset.exp25Visible='true';const node=tag;
 feedbackTimer=setTimeout(()=>{if(node===tag)tag.dataset.exp25Visible='false'},duration);
}
// Input is observed, but never replaced: native sliders still set the real physical values.
app.addEventListener('input',e=>{
 if(!active()||!vp?.classList.contains('exp23-experiment'))return;
 if(!e.target?.matches?.('#rng-length,#rng-mass,#rng-amp'))return;
 const type=e.target.id;
 setPose('tune',750);
 if(type==='rng-length')say('長さを変えて、振れる速さを観察しよう',1600);
 else if(type==='rng-mass')say('重さを変えても周期はほぼ同じだよ',1600);
 else say('振れ幅にも注目してみよう',1600);
},true);
app.addEventListener('click',e=>{
 if(!active()||!vp)return;
 if(e.target?.closest?.('#exp22Interact,.exp22-apparatus')){
  if(vp.classList.contains('exp23-experiment')){setPose('idle',0);return;}
  const near=vp.querySelector('.exp22-interact')?.dataset.near==='true';
  if(near){setPose('reach',950);opening=true;}else{opening=true;}
 }
 const button=e.target?.closest?.('#runStage');
 if(button&&vp.classList.contains('exp23-experiment')){
  const node=vp;setPose('cast',750);say('調整した振り子で、時計塔を動かそう！',850);
  clearTimeout(castTimer);castTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
   if(vp===node&&!state.stageDoneNow){setPose('think',1150);say('あと少し。周期の差を確かめよう。',1950)}
  },820);
 }
},true);
app.addEventListener('furiko:clockwork-started',e=>{
 if(!active()||!vp||e.detail?.stage!=='s01')return;
 clearTimeout(castTimer);setPose('cheer',2400);say('やった！ 周期が合って、歯車が動いた！',2600);
},false);
function frame(){
 if(active()){
  const next=app.querySelector('.stage-viewport.exp22-enabled');
  if(next&&next!==vp)mount(next);
  if(vp&&!winner)mountVictory();
  if(vp&&opening&&vp.classList.contains('exp23-experiment')){opening=false;setPose('reach',850);say('装置に触れて、糸の長さを調整しよう',1700);}
 }else if(vp){vp=null;hero=null;lab=null;world=null;clock=null;tag=null;winner=null;opening=false;clearTimeout(poseTimer);clearTimeout(feedbackTimer);clearTimeout(castTimer);}
 requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>

<style id="clocktower-environment-v026-style">
/* v0.26 – world lighting. An enhancement of the real first-stage world, not a replacement for the physics canvas. */
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-world{--exp26-hero-x:50%;--exp26-hero-y:67%;--exp26-shadow-x:50%;--exp26-shadow-y:72%;--exp26-light-radius:150px;--exp26-ambient:.27;}
.exp26-environment{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;isolation:isolate;opacity:1;transition:opacity .6s ease;}
.exp26-environment>*{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;}
/* Illumination stays visually anchored to the actual character's position. */
.exp26-lamp-pool{inset:0;z-index:1;background:radial-gradient(circle var(--exp26-light-radius) at var(--exp26-hero-x) var(--exp26-hero-y),#ffe3a144 0%,#d8bd6630 24%,#b0d9dd18 48%,transparent 76%);mix-blend-mode:screen;filter:blur(6px);}
.exp26-lamp-floor{inset:0;z-index:1;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 130px 30px at var(--exp26-shadow-x) var(--exp26-shadow-y),#fce7aa32 2%,#c9ab7c20 27%,transparent 85%);filter:blur(4px);}
.exp26-lamp-shadow{left:var(--exp26-shadow-x);top:var(--exp26-shadow-y);width:100px;height:22px;z-index:2;transform:translate(-50%,-20%) skewX(-28deg);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 40% 50%,#010810bb,#09132184 51%,transparent 75%);filter:blur(6px);opacity:.75;transition:opacity .35s;}
.exp26-ambient-haze{inset:0;z-index:0;opacity:.55;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#10192925 4%,transparent 32%,#020f174d 83%,#020a13b8),radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% 37%,#6fc9b325,transparent 39%);transition:background .9s ease,opacity .8s ease;}
.exp26-glints{inset:0;z-index:2;opacity:.48;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,#ffe6a8 1px,transparent 2px),radial-gradient(circle,#a5efe7 1px,transparent 2px);background-size:144px 126px,178px 146px;background-position:12px 57px,84px 20px;animation:exp26-drift 21s linear infinite;mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 10%,black 30%,black 78%,transparent 94%);}
@keyframes exp26-drift{to{background-position:47px -120px,40px -195px}}
/* Architectural lamps exist in the same coordinate plane as the player and clock machinery. */
.exp26-sconce{width:40px;height:66px;z-index:1;top:45%;filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 6px #00101cb9);transform:translateX(calc(var(--exp23-camera,0px)*.3));}
.exp26-sconce.left{left:9%}.exp26-sconce.right{right:9%;top:42%}
.exp26-sconce:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:7px;right:7px;top:2px;height:27px;border:2px solid #aa9871;border-radius:49% 49% 28% 28%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#3d454e,#b59b65 50%,#293945);box-shadow:inset 0 0 10px #0a1a2bd9,0 0 0 2px #0b15276b;}
.exp26-sconce:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:3px;right:3px;top:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:#f7db9a;box-shadow:0 0 22px 10px #ffe3a665,0 0 67px 30px #e8ca7b28;opacity:.32;transition:opacity 1s,box-shadow 1s;}
.exp26-sconce .exp26-bracket{position:absolute;width:38px;height:7px;left:1px;top:29px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(#a99a7a,#293746);box-shadow:0 5px 0 #141f2c;}
.exp26-sconce .exp26-ray{position:absolute;left:-45px;top:20px;width:130px;height:170px;opacity:.15;background:conic-gradient(from 145deg at 50% 0%,transparent,#f2dc9a58,transparent 65deg);filter:blur(16px);transition:opacity 1.1s ease;}
/* Power conduction follows stage completion state. It has no effect on the science simulation. */
.exp26-conduits{inset:0;z-index:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;opacity:0;transition:opacity .85s ease;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px #a0ffdbc3);}
.exp26-conduits .exp26-cable{fill:none;stroke:#abdfc1;stroke-width:2.1;stroke-linecap:round;opacity:.42;}
.exp26-conduits .exp26-current{fill:none;stroke:#dcffb8;stroke-width:3.1;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:4 22;animation:exp26-current 2s linear infinite;}
@keyframes exp26-current{to{stroke-dashoffset:-52}}
.exp26-structure-glow{inset:6% 0 12%;opacity:0;z-index:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 64% 30%,#b7ffbb26,transparent 39%),linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#9becc318 60%,transparent);filter:blur(11px);transition:opacity .9s ease;}
/* After solving the real stage, lighting remains restored even after reload. */
.exp26-environment[data-exp26-powered="true"] .exp26-ambient-haze{opacity:.17}
.exp26-environment[data-exp26-powered="true"] .exp26-structure-glow{opacity:1}
.exp26-environment[data-exp26-powered="true"] .exp26-conduits{opacity:.8}
.exp26-environment[data-exp26-powered="true"] .exp26-sconce:after{opacity:.95;box-shadow:0 0 28px 12px #fff1aaaf,0 0 74px 29px #a1eaba50}
.exp26-environment[data-exp26-powered="true"] .exp26-sconce .exp26-ray{opacity:.8}
.exp26-environment[data-exp26-powered="true"] .exp26-lamp-pool{filter:blur(8px) brightness(1.2)}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-world:has(.exp26-environment[data-exp26-powered="true"]) .exp22-character{filter:drop-shadow(0 15px 12px #000d) drop-shadow(0 0 11px #a6f5cd85)}
.exp26-environment[data-exp26-powered="true"] .exp26-glints{opacity:.92}
/* The physical reaction is a short, bounded burst; no permanently flashing screen. */
.exp26-revival{inset:0;z-index:5;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;mix-blend-mode:screen;background:radial-gradient(circle at 74% 46%,#fffce1cf 0%,#9fece169 18%,#60dbbf25 37%,transparent 67%);pointer-events:none;}
.exp26-environment.exp26-reviving .exp26-revival{visibility:visible;animation:exp26-revive 1.5s ease-out both}
@keyframes exp26-revive{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.76)}23%{opacity:.78;transform:scale(1)}64%{opacity:.32;transform:scale(1.13)}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.18)}}
.exp26-environment.exp26-reviving .exp26-sconce:after{animation:exp26-ignite .65s ease-out 2}
@keyframes exp26-ignite{0%{transform:scale(.7);opacity:.2}40%{transform:scale(1.35);opacity:1}100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:.95}}
.exp26-stage-caption{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:50%;bottom:calc(288px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));transform:translateX(-50%);max-width:min(280px,68%);padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid #b8e9d46b;border-radius:999px;color:#c6f8e9;background:#071e2ac9;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-shadow:0 1px 4px #000;opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s ease;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;text-align:center;}
.exp26-environment[data-exp26-powered="true"] + .exp26-stage-caption{opacity:.88}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp23-experiment .exp26-environment{opacity:.5}
body[data-scene="world"] .exp23-experiment .exp26-stage-caption{opacity:0}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .exp26-sconce{transform:scale(.65) translateX(calc(var(--exp23-camera,0px)*.3));transform-origin:center top;top:37%}
 .exp26-sconce.left{left:4%}.exp26-sconce.right{right:2%;top:34%;}
 .exp26-stage-caption{bottom:calc(267px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));font-size:9px;max-width:60%}
 .exp26-conduits{opacity:0!important}
 .exp26-environment[data-exp26-powered="true"] .exp26-conduits{opacity:.55!important}
}
@media(max-width:360px){.exp26-sconce.right{display:none}.exp26-sconce.left{top:37%;left:3%}.exp26-stage-caption{bottom:calc(247px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));font-size:8px;max-width:55%;}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 .exp26-glints,.exp26-conduits .exp26-current,.exp26-environment.exp26-reviving .exp26-revival,.exp26-environment.exp26-reviving .exp26-sconce:after{animation:none!important}
 .exp26-environment.exp26-reviving .exp26-revival{opacity:0!important}
 .exp26-environment,.exp26-sconce:after,.exp26-sconce .exp26-ray,.exp26-structure-glow,.exp26-conduits{transition:none!important}
}
</style>
<script id="clocktower-environment-v026-script">
(()=>{'use strict';
/* World lighting reads positions, completion and action cues only. Existing physics, controls and saves are authoritative. */
const app=document.getElementById('app');if(!app)return;
const isStage1=()=>{try{return document.body.dataset.scene==='world'&&state.view==='world'&&state.sid==='s01'}catch(_){return false}};
const reduced=window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
const sceneMarkup=`<div class="exp26-ambient-haze"></div><div class="exp26-structure-glow"></div><svg class="exp26-conduits" viewBox="0 0 1000 600" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><path class="exp26-cable" d="M90 345 Q235 270 385 331 T785 309 Q835 286 918 239"/><path class="exp26-current" d="M90 345 Q235 270 385 331 T785 309 Q835 286 918 239"/></svg><div class="exp26-lamp-floor"></div><div class="exp26-lamp-pool"></div><div class="exp26-lamp-shadow"></div><div class="exp26-sconce left"><span class="exp26-bracket"></span><span class="exp26-ray"></span></div><div class="exp26-sconce right"><span class="exp26-bracket"></span><span class="exp26-ray"></span></div><div class="exp26-glints"></div><div class="exp26-revival"></div>`;
let viewport=null,layer=null,light=null,hero=null,revivalTimer=null,lastDraw=0,lastPowered=null;
function mount(v){
 viewport=v;layer=v.querySelector('.exp22-world');light=null;hero=null;lastPowered=null;
 if(!layer)return;
 hero=layer.querySelector('.exp22-character');if(!hero)return;
 light=document.createElement('div');light.className='exp26-environment';light.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');light.innerHTML=sceneMarkup;
 // Keep the architecture behind the original character, machine and interaction button.
 const anchor=layer.querySelector('.exp24-mechanism,.exp22-character');layer.insertBefore(light,anchor);
 syncPowered();syncPosition();
}
function syncPowered(){if(!light)return;
 const completed=!!(state.progress&&state.progress.s01);
 if(completed!==lastPowered){light.dataset.exp26Powered=String(completed);lastPowered=completed;}
}
function syncPosition(){if(!light||!hero||!layer)return;
 // Read actual rendered geometry to keep the pool and floor shadow attached at all screen widths.
 const bounds=layer.getBoundingClientRect(),rect=hero.getBoundingClientRect();
 if(!bounds.width||!bounds.height||!rect.width)return;
 const x=((rect.left+rect.width*.52-bounds.left)/bounds.width*100).toFixed(2)+'%';
 const y=((rect.top+rect.height*.57-bounds.top)/bounds.height*100).toFixed(2)+'%';
 const shadowY=((rect.bottom-rect.height*.06-bounds.top)/bounds.height*100).toFixed(2)+'%';
 layer.style.setProperty('--exp26-hero-x',x);layer.style.setProperty('--exp26-hero-y',y);
 layer.style.setProperty('--exp26-shadow-x',x);layer.style.setProperty('--exp26-shadow-y',shadowY);
 const near=layer.querySelector('.exp22-character')?.classList.contains('near');
 layer.style.setProperty('--exp26-light-radius',near?'190px':'150px');
}
app.addEventListener('furiko:clockwork-started',e=>{
 if(!isStage1()||e.detail?.stage!=='s01'||!light)return;
 syncPowered();if(reduced?.matches)return;
 light.classList.remove('exp26-reviving');void light.offsetWidth;light.classList.add('exp26-reviving');
 clearTimeout(revivalTimer);const local=light;revivalTimer=setTimeout(()=>{local.classList.remove('exp26-reviving')},1750);
});
function frame(time){
 if(isStage1()){
  const next=app.querySelector('.stage-viewport.exp22-enabled');
  if(next&&next!==viewport)mount(next);
  if(light&&next===viewport&&time-lastDraw>45){lastDraw=time;syncPowered();if(!reduced?.matches||time%240<65)syncPosition();}
 }else if(viewport){clearTimeout(revivalTimer);viewport=null;layer=null;light=null;hero=null;lastPowered=null;}
 requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>

<style id="clocktower-depth-v027-style">
/* v0.27 – world-space parallax, perspective ground and sprite-ground contact.
 * Decorative architecture is non-interactive; the science evaluator is unchanged. */
body[data-scene="world"] .exp22-world{
 --exp27-near:0px;--exp27-mid:0px;--exp27-far:0px;
 --exp27-lift:0px;--exp27-ground-x:50%;--exp27-ground-y:74%;--exp27-ground-scale:1;
}
.exp27-depth{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;isolation:isolate;}
.exp27-depth>*{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;will-change:transform;}
/* Behind the foreground, repeated arched vaults give the existing painted architecture a fixed depth order. */
.exp27-gallery{inset:24% -28% 23%;opacity:.45;
 transform:translate3d(var(--exp27-far),calc(var(--exp27-lift) * -.26),0);
 background:
  radial-gradient(ellipse at 49% 33%,#cfe4d322,transparent 52%),
  repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 16.4%,#06192c78 16.6% 17.1%,#dac18a38 17.4%,#07152285 18.1%,transparent 18.8% 32.8%);
 mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,black 22%,black 76%,transparent 100%);
 filter:drop-shadow(0 0 11px #0b1b24);
}
.exp27-vault-light{inset:4% -15% 31%;opacity:.26;
 transform:translate3d(var(--exp27-far),calc(var(--exp27-lift) * -.12),0);
 background:repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 51% 100%,transparent 0 89px,#e8d5b749 91px 93px,transparent 96px 175px);
 mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,black,transparent 66%);
}
/* Path-accurate lines on the stone floor converge on a single vanishing point. */
.exp27-floor{left:-19%;width:138%;bottom:7%;height:39%;overflow:hidden;
 transform:translate3d(var(--exp27-mid),calc(var(--exp27-lift) * .33),0);
 clip-path:polygon(34% 0,66% 0,100% 100%,0 100%);
 background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b6c4b80b 0%,#abbcb71a 30%,#233b445b 72%,#09182382 100%);
 opacity:.67;
 box-shadow:inset 0 8px 30px #e5d29f1a;
}
.exp27-floor svg{position:absolute;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;opacity:.64;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #ffe4b624)}
.exp27-floor .exp27-etched{fill:none;stroke:#c5d2c0;stroke-width:1.45;stroke-opacity:.34}
.exp27-floor .exp27-lines{fill:none;stroke:#efd7a8;stroke-width:2.3;stroke-opacity:.36}
.exp27-floor .exp27-cross{fill:none;stroke:#d8b98d;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-opacity:.42}
.exp27-floor-bloom{inset:auto -5% 7%;height:21%;opacity:.4;
 transform:translate3d(var(--exp27-mid),0,0);
 background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 49% 74%,#ffdc9e21 1%,transparent 62%);filter:blur(8px)}
/* Foreground depth frame: separate from the canvas, with deliberately slower/stronger near-camera parallax. */
.exp27-pillar{top:16%;height:68%;width:clamp(68px,17vw,156px);opacity:.72;
 filter:drop-shadow(0 9px 24px #020d18bb);}
.exp27-pillar.left{left:-40px;transform:translate3d(var(--exp27-near),calc(var(--exp27-lift) * -.45),0)}
.exp27-pillar.right{right:-47px;transform:translate3d(calc(var(--exp27-near)*-.82),calc(var(--exp27-lift) * -.45),0) scaleX(-1);opacity:.70}
.exp27-pillar svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;}
.exp27-pillar .stone{fill:#102836;stroke:#887960;stroke-width:2.1;}
.exp27-pillar .stone-inner{fill:#2c4850;fill-opacity:.7;stroke:#ccb88a;stroke-opacity:.5;stroke-width:2;}
.exp27-pillar .edge{stroke:#f0dbac;stroke-opacity:.4;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none;}
.exp27-pillar .carving{fill:#d3b678;fill-opacity:.27;stroke:#d3b678;stroke-opacity:.5;stroke-width:1;}
.exp27-contact{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:var(--exp27-ground-x);top:var(--exp27-ground-y);width:105px;height:23px;
 transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(var(--exp27-ground-scale));transform-origin:center;
 background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#02101cde 2%,#061525ad 38%,#050c1780 57%,transparent 77%);
 border-radius:50%;filter:blur(4px);pointer-events:none;opacity:.95;transition:opacity .12s linear;}
.exp27-contact:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-2px 3px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #d7c99c25;box-shadow:0 0 12px #ecdcb21e;opacity:.9;}
.exp27-contact[data-walking="true"]{animation:exp27-contact-step .41s ease-in-out infinite alternate;}
@keyframes exp27-contact-step{to{opacity:.67;filter:blur(5px);}}
/* Small floor-bound footsteps, never clouds floating beside the character. */
.exp27-step{position:absolute;left:var(--exp27-ground-x);top:var(--exp27-ground-y);width:12px;height:8px;
 border-radius:50%;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;background:#d3bfa26f;box-shadow:0 0 7px #e1d0a76d;
 animation:exp27-step .66s ease-out both;}
@keyframes exp27-step{0%{transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--exp27-step-offset)),0) scale(.55);opacity:.65}
 100%{transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--exp27-step-offset)), -18px) scale(2.4);opacity:0}}
.exp27-awaken .exp27-floor-bloom{animation:exp27-floor-flash 1.4s ease-out both;}
@keyframes exp27-floor-flash{0%{opacity:.25}25%{opacity:.95;filter:brightness(1.65) blur(5px)}100%{opacity:.4}}
/* Experiment remains visually attached to the world, but the decorative near architecture recedes. */
.exp23-experiment .exp27-depth{opacity:.45;transition:opacity .25s}
.exp23-experiment .exp27-pillar{opacity:.15}
.exp23-experiment .exp27-contact{opacity:.4}
/* Keep the main scene in front of the new spatial layers: the protagonist and controls always remain legible. */
.exp22-world>.exp22-character{z-index:4!important;}
.exp22-world>.exp22-apparatus{z-index:5!important;}
.exp22-world>.exp24-mechanism{z-index:3!important;}
.exp22-world>.exp27-contact,.exp22-world>.exp27-step{z-index:2}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .exp27-gallery{opacity:.4;inset:28% -30% 25%}
 .exp27-floor{left:-30%;width:160%;bottom:10%;height:33%;opacity:.67}
 .exp27-pillar{width:68px;top:20%;height:60%;}
 .exp27-pillar.left{left:-44px}.exp27-pillar.right{right:-48px}
 .exp27-contact{width:78px;height:15px;filter:blur(3px)}
}
@media(max-width:360px){.exp27-floor{bottom:11%;height:30%;}.exp27-pillar.right{opacity:.45}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 .exp27-step{display:none}.exp27-contact[data-walking="true"],.exp27-awaken .exp27-floor-bloom{animation:none!important}
 .exp27-gallery,.exp27-vault-light,.exp27-floor,.exp27-pillar{will-change:auto}
}
</style>
<script id="clocktower-depth-v027-script">
(()=>{'use strict';
 const app=document.getElementById('app');if(!app)return;
 const reduced=window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
 const active=()=>{try{return document.body.dataset.scene==='world'&&state.view==='world'&&state.sid==='s01'}catch(_){return false}};
 const floorSVG=`<svg viewBox="0 0 1000 420" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><g class="exp27-lines"><path d="M500 0 L0 420 M500 0 L158 420 M500 0 L310 420 M500 0 L428 420 M500 0 L572 420 M500 0 L690 420 M500 0 L842 420 M500 0 L1000 420"/></g><g class="exp27-etched"><path d="M475 40 H525 M442 88 H558 M399 149 H601 M341 216 H659 M262 292 H738 M160 366 H840 M0 417 H1000"/></g><g class="exp27-cross"><path d="M330 219l13 -8 13 8 -13 8z M645 219l13 -8 13 8 -13 8z M485 297l13 -8 13 8 -13 8z M493 152l7 -4 7 4 -7 4z"/></g></svg>`;
 const pillar=`<svg viewBox="0 0 120 530" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><path class="stone" d="M0 0H88L112 23 103 52 94 55 92 438 119 470 118 500 97 530H0Z"/><path class="stone-inner" d="M53 45 84 52 77 438 96 466 55 461Z"/><path class="edge" d="M92 55 91 434 M52 42V463 M28 40 29 454"/><path class="carving" d="M20 30H104L114 48 12 48Z M14 450H105L116 467H13Z M9 475H117V493H0Z"/><path class="edge" d="M0 20H95 M7 490H117"/><circle class="carving" cx="79" cy="33" r="8"/><path class="edge" d="M69 65l12 23 12 -23 M69 429l12 -23 12 23"/></svg>`;
 const markup=`<div class="exp27-gallery"></div><div class="exp27-vault-light"></div><div class="exp27-floor"><div aria-hidden="true">${floorSVG}</div></div><div class="exp27-floor-bloom"></div><div class="exp27-pillar left">${pillar}</div><div class="exp27-pillar right">${pillar}</div>`;
 let viewport=null,world=null,hero=null,contact=null,depth=null,last=0,lastStep=0,stepSide=1,awakenTimer=0,cam=0;
 function mount(v){
  viewport=v;world=v.querySelector('.exp22-world');hero=world?.querySelector('.exp22-character');
  contact=null;depth=null;cam=0;last=0;lastStep=0;stepSide=1;
  if(!world||!hero)return;
  depth=document.createElement('div');depth.className='exp27-depth';depth.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');depth.innerHTML=markup;
  const anchor=world.querySelector('.exp26-environment,.exp24-mechanism,.exp22-character');world.insertBefore(depth,anchor);
  contact=document.createElement('div');contact.className='exp27-contact';contact.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');world.insertBefore(contact,hero);
  sync(0,true);
 }
 function sync(time,force=false){if(!world||!hero||!viewport)return;
  const camera=parseFloat(viewport.style.getPropertyValue('--exp23-camera'))||0;
  const t=last?Math.min(1,(time-last)/130):1;cam+=(camera-cam)*t;
  world.style.setProperty('--exp27-far',(cam*.15).toFixed(2)+'px');
  world.style.setProperty('--exp27-mid',(-cam*.43).toFixed(2)+'px');
  world.style.setProperty('--exp27-near',(-cam*.79).toFixed(2)+'px');
  const vertical=parseFloat(viewport.style.getPropertyValue('--exp23-depth'))||0;
  world.style.setProperty('--exp27-lift',(vertical*.65).toFixed(2)+'px');
  const wr=world.getBoundingClientRect(),hr=hero.getBoundingClientRect();
  if(wr.width>0&&wr.height>0&&hr.width>0){
   world.style.setProperty('--exp27-ground-x',(((hr.left+hr.width*.5-wr.left)/wr.width)*100).toFixed(2)+'%');
   world.style.setProperty('--exp27-ground-y',(((hr.bottom-hr.height*.045-wr.top)/wr.height)*100).toFixed(2)+'%');
   const scale=parseFloat(hero.style.getPropertyValue('--exp22-scale'))||1;
   world.style.setProperty('--exp27-ground-scale',Math.max(.6,Math.min(1.3,scale)).toFixed(2));
  }
  const walking=hero.classList.contains('walking')&&!viewport.classList.contains('exp23-experiment');
  if(contact)contact.dataset.walking=String(walking);
  if(walking&&!reduced?.matches&&time-lastStep>360&&time>0){
    stepSide*=-1;lastStep=time;
    const node=document.createElement('span');node.className='exp27-step';node.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    node.style.setProperty('--exp27-step-offset',stepSide*12+'px');
    world.append(node);setTimeout(()=>node.remove(),680);
  }
 }
 app.addEventListener('furiko:clockwork-started',e=>{
  if(!active()||e.detail?.stage!=='s01'||!depth||reduced?.matches)return;
  depth.classList.remove('exp27-awaken');void depth.offsetWidth;depth.classList.add('exp27-awaken');
  clearTimeout(awakenTimer);const local=depth;awakenTimer=setTimeout(()=>local.classList.remove('exp27-awaken'),1550);
 });
 function frame(time){
  if(active()){
   const v=app.querySelector('.stage-viewport.exp22-enabled');
   if(v&&v!==viewport)mount(v);
   if(v===viewport&&world&&time-last>35){sync(time);last=time;}
  }else if(viewport){viewport=null;world=null;hero=null;depth=null;contact=null;last=0;clearTimeout(awakenTimer)}
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
 }
 requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>

<style id="exp28-discovery-style">
/* v0.28: optional science discoveries built into the first explorable room. */
.exp22-world .exp28-objects{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:5;}
.exp28-object{position:absolute;left:var(--obj-left);bottom:var(--obj-bottom);width:66px;height:72px;
 display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1px;
 transform:translate(-50%,0);border:0;background:none;color:#fff0bc;pointer-events:auto;
 cursor:pointer;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 7px #041421cc);transition:filter .2s,opacity .2s;}
.exp28-object svg{width:44px;height:51px;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 9px #e7c9887a);}
.exp28-object .exp28-label{max-width:95px;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:0 2px 6px #061421,0 1px 2px #061421;
 background:#112c3ad4;border:1px solid #b69b6e69;border-radius:999px;font-size:9px;line-height:1.2;font-weight:800;padding:3px 7px;}
.exp28-object:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:72px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;bottom:5px;
 background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#eecf8347,transparent 72%);z-index:-1;animation:exp28-glimmer 2.9s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.exp28-object[data-near="true"]:not([data-found="true"]) svg{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 15px #e8d099e6)}
.exp28-object[data-found="true"] .exp28-label{color:#d8f9db;background:#15392edb;border-color:#93e6ae80}
.exp28-object[data-found="true"] svg{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px #79eeb77b)}
.exp28-object[data-found="true"]:before{background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#85dab03a,transparent 72%);animation:none}
.exp28-object:focus-visible,.exp28-ledger:focus-visible,.exp28-panel button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #95f7e0;outline-offset:3px}
.exp28-object:active{transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(.94)}
@keyframes exp28-glimmer{to{opacity:.28;transform:scale(.68)}}
.exp28-ledger{position:absolute;top:23%;left:12px;z-index:8;pointer-events:auto;
 display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:10px;
 border:1px solid #c6b98f99;background:#071b2be8;color:#fff4d3;box-shadow:0 4px 15px #02142199;
 font-size:11px;font-weight:900;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);}
.exp28-ledger b{color:#baf4d9}
.exp28-ledger small{display:block;font-size:8px;color:#d8caa2;line-height:1.1;font-weight:700}
.exp28-ledger[aria-expanded="true"]{border-color:#8ce5c9}
.exp28-panel{position:absolute;inset:auto 12px 11% 12px;z-index:18;pointer-events:auto;
 max-width:560px;margin:auto;padding:16px 17px 14px;max-height:70%;overflow:auto;
 color:#f5f2e3;background:linear-gradient(153deg,#183546f5,#0b1e2cf8 70%);border:1px solid #edcf91a6;
 border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 17px 58px #020c17e6,inset 0 1px #ffffff19;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);}
.exp28-panel[hidden]{display:none!important}
.exp28-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:3px;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#eccc91,#82eacc,transparent)}
.exp28-panel h3{font-size:20px;color:#ffe4a9;line-height:1.3;margin:5px 34px 7px 0;letter-spacing:.02em;}
.exp28-panel .exp28-kicker{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.15em;font-weight:900;color:#a2ddcb;text-transform:uppercase}
.exp28-panel .exp28-question{font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;margin:12px 0 10px;font-weight:800}
.exp28-panel .exp28-body{font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;color:#d7e5e4;margin:3px 0 11px}
.exp28-panel .exp28-close{position:absolute;top:11px;right:11px;width:33px;height:33px;border:1px solid #e2c79088;
 border-radius:50%;color:#fff4d0;background:#122b3b;font-weight:900;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer}
.exp28-choices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 8px}
.exp28-choices button,.exp28-continue{border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #c6c5ab8c;padding:12px 10px;
 background:#1b3545;color:#fff2dc;font-size:12px;font-weight:850;min-height:49px;cursor:pointer;}
.exp28-choices button:hover,.exp28-continue:hover{border-color:#f0d18e;background:#2a4b59}
.exp28-choices button[data-correct="true"]{border-color:#9de1b3;background:#234f45;color:#e4fbe9}
.exp28-feedback{min-height:23px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;color:#f3d597;font-weight:800;margin-top:5px}
.exp28-feedback.success{color:#b7eccc}
.exp28-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
.exp28-continue{background:linear-gradient(110deg,#ffe2a0,#d4ae6c);color:#19313d;border-color:#ffe7b9;min-height:39px;padding:8px 14px}
.exp28-note-list{display:grid;gap:8px;margin:11px 0}
.exp28-note-item{border:1px solid #b9a67e44;border-radius:10px;background:#0d2433a3;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:start;font-size:12px;}
.exp28-note-item strong{display:block;color:#ffe6ac}
.exp28-note-item small{display:block;line-height:1.55;color:#d8e5df;font-size:11px;margin-top:3px;}
.exp28-note-item[data-found="true"]{border-color:#9fdaad69;background:#1c3b3699}
.exp28-note-item .seal{font-size:16px;line-height:1.2;color:#b3e8b8}
.exp28-panel .exp28-special{margin-top:10px;background:#27544477;padding:11px;border:1px solid #91d2a36b;
 border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:#ecfce8}
.exp28-world-toast{position:absolute;left:50%;top:40%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:7;
 font-size:12px;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #e8d19b99;
 color:#ffe3a0;background:#0e2633dc;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 0 18px #ffdf7e38;pointer-events:none;
 animation:exp28-toast .85s ease-out forwards;}
@keyframes exp28-toast{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-18%) scale(.86)}20%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-130%)}}
.exp28-world-fixed .exp28-object{opacity:.16;pointer-events:none}
.exp28-world-fixed .exp28-ledger{opacity:.45;pointer-events:none}
@media(min-width:761px){.exp28-panel{inset:auto 16px 11% auto;width:min(500px,50%)}.exp28-ledger{top:24%;left:20px}}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .exp28-object{width:50px;height:59px}.exp28-object svg{width:35px;height:39px}

 .exp28-object:before{width:53px;height:26px}
 .exp28-ledger{top:24%;left:8px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:10px}
 .exp28-panel{inset:auto 8px 19% 8px;max-height:min(55%,460px);padding:14px 12px 12px}
