}
@media(max-width:360px){.exp28-panel{bottom:19%;max-height:55%;}.exp28-ledger{top:25%;font-size:9px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.exp28-object:before,.exp28-world-toast{animation:none}}
</style>
<script id="exp28-discovery-script">
(()=>{'use strict';
 const app=document.getElementById('app');if(!app)return;
 const STORE='furiko-clocktower-discoveries-v028';
 const points=[
  {id:'length',title:'古い振り子',label:'古い振り子',x:.13,z:.58,
   q:'振り子の1往復の時間を短くしたい。どうする？',options:['糸を短くする','おもりを重くする'],answer:0,
   explain:'小さな振れ幅では、糸を短くすると1往復の時間（周期）は短くなる。時計塔の目標は約1.00秒。',detail:'長さを変えると周期が変わる。',icon:'pend'},
  {id:'mass',title:'真ちゅうのおもり',label:'おもり',x:.41,z:.72,
   q:'糸の長さをそのままにして、おもりだけ重くしたら？',options:['1往復の時間はほぼ変わらない','必ず速く振れる'],answer:0,
   explain:'空気抵抗などの影響が小さく、振れ幅も小さいとき、周期はおもりの重さにほぼ左右されない。',detail:'条件をそろえると、重さを変えても周期はほぼ一定。',icon:'weight'},
  {id:'record',title:'振れ幅の記録帳',label:'振れ幅',x:.61,z:.33,
   q:'小さな振れ幅だけを変えたら、1往復の時間は？',options:['ほぼ同じ','大きく変わる'],answer:0,
   explain:'小さな振れ幅（5〜15°）では、振れ幅だけ変えても周期はほぼ同じ。大きな振れ幅では少し長くなる。',detail:'小さな振れ幅で条件をそろえて比べよう。旧版の取得済み記録も引き継いでいるよ。',icon:'book'}
 ];
 const icon={
  pend:`<svg viewBox="0 0 56 62" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 9H48M28 11V35" fill="none" stroke="#e9cc8f" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M28 12L39 40" fill="none" stroke="#a6edf0" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="39" cy="44" r="9" fill="#a4e6db" stroke="#ffe1a3" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M9 52H48" stroke="#f4ddaa" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M12 16L5 22M45 16L51 22" stroke="#f2d7a9" stroke-width="3"/></svg>`,
  weight:`<svg viewBox="0 0 56 62" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M17 17Q17 4 28 4T39 17" fill="none" stroke="#d6bc7a" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M15 23H41L47 49Q48 54 42 56H14Q8 54 9 49Z" fill="#b9b09a" stroke="#ffe3a3" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M19 27H37M28 29V47" stroke="#f8e7b0" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="28" cy="41" r="4" fill="#6c827f"/></svg>`,
  book:`<svg viewBox="0 0 56 62" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 10Q21 5 28 13Q35 5 48 10V52Q35 46 28 53Q21 46 9 52Z" fill="#d5b881" stroke="#fff2c0" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M28 14V52M14 20L24 18M14 27L24 25M33 20L43 18M33 28L43 26M14 35L24 33M33 36L43 34" stroke="#654f40" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`
 };
 let found={};try{const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE)||'{}');if(saved&&typeof saved==='object')found=saved;}catch(_){found={}}
 let view=null,world=null,layer=null,panel=null,bookBtn=null,loc=null,active=null,wrong=0,lastPos={x:.49,z:.12},timer=null;
 const alive=()=>{try{return document.body.dataset.scene==='world'&&state.view==='world'&&state.sid==='s01'}catch(_){return false}};
 const learned=()=>points.filter(p=>found[p.id]).length;
 const persist=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(STORE,JSON.stringify(found))}catch(_){}};
 const lookup=id=>points.find(p=>p.id===id);
 const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
 function art(){return points.map(p=>`<button type="button" class="exp28-object" data-exp28-id="${p.id}" data-found="${!!found[p.id]}" data-near="false" style="--obj-left:${(50+(p.x-.5)*54).toFixed(2)}%;--obj-bottom:${(26+p.z*19).toFixed(2)}%;" aria-label="${p.title}を調べる">${icon[p.icon]}<span class="exp28-label">${found[p.id]?'✓ ':''}${p.label}</span></button>`).join('')}
 function install(v){
  view=v;world=v.querySelector('.exp22-world');if(!world)return;
  layer=document.createElement('div');layer.className='exp28-objects';layer.innerHTML=art();world.append(layer);
  bookBtn=document.createElement('button');bookBtn.className='exp28-ledger';bookBtn.type='button';bookBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');bookBtn.innerHTML=`<span aria-hidden="true">✦</span><span>探索記録 <b>${learned()}/3</b><small>調べて法則を発見</small></span>`;world.append(bookBtn);
  panel=document.createElement('section');panel.className='exp28-panel';panel.hidden=true;panel.setAttribute('role','dialog');panel.setAttribute('aria-modal','false');panel.setAttribute('aria-label','探索の発見');world.append(panel);
  layer.addEventListener('click',e=>{const button=e.target.closest('[data-exp28-id]');if(button)select(button.dataset.exp28Id)});
  bookBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>openNotebook());
  panel.addEventListener('click',e=>{
   if(e.target.closest('.exp28-close')){close();return}
   const option=e.target.closest('[data-exp28-option]');if(option){answer(Number(option.dataset.exp28Option));return}
   const next=e.target.closest('[data-exp28-action]');if(next){const kind=next.dataset.exp28Action;close();if(kind==='experiment')world.querySelector('.exp22-interact')?.click();}
  });
  panel.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();close()}});
  v.classList.remove('exp28-world-fixed');active=null;wrong=0;
  const guide=v.querySelector('#exp22Guide');if(guide)guide.textContent='光る手がかりを調べよう。装置へ直接向かってもOK！';
  updateStatus();
 }
 function updateStatus(){if(!world)return;
  if(bookBtn){bookBtn.querySelector('b').textContent=learned()+'/3';bookBtn.setAttribute('aria-label',`発見ノート ${learned()}/3。開く`)}
  for(const p of points){const node=layer?.querySelector(`[data-exp28-id="${p.id}"]`);if(!node)continue;
   node.dataset.found=String(!!found[p.id]);node.querySelector('.exp28-label').textContent=(found[p.id]?'✓ ':'')+p.label;node.dataset.near=String(Math.hypot(lastPos.x-p.x,(lastPos.z-p.z)*1.2)<.12);
  }
  if(view)view.classList.toggle('exp28-world-fixed',!panel.hidden||view.classList.contains('exp23-experiment'));
 }
 function close(){if(panel){panel.hidden=true;bookBtn?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');view?.classList.remove('exp28-world-fixed');}active=null;updateStatus();}
 function show(content){if(!panel)return;panel.innerHTML=content;panel.hidden=false;bookBtn?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');view?.classList.add('exp28-world-fixed');panel.querySelector('.exp28-close')?.focus({preventScroll:true});}
 const closer='<button class="exp28-close" type="button" aria-label="閉じる">×</button>';
 function select(id){if(!alive()||!view||view.classList.contains('exp23-experiment'))return;
  const p=lookup(id);if(!p)return;
  if(Math.hypot(lastPos.x-p.x,(lastPos.z-p.z)*1.2)>.13){
   active=id;
   app.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('furiko:explore-go',{detail:{id,x:p.x,z:p.z}}));
   notify('✦ '+p.label+'へ向かう…');
  }else openPoint(id);
 }
 function notify(message){if(!world)return;world.querySelector('.exp28-world-toast')?.remove();
  const node=document.createElement('div');node.className='exp28-world-toast';node.setAttribute('role','status');node.textContent=message;world.append(node);setTimeout(()=>node.remove(),900);
 }
 function openPoint(id){const p=lookup(id);if(!p||!alive())return;active=id;wrong=0;
  if(found[id]){show(closer+`<div class="exp28-kicker">DISCOVERY / REVISIT</div><h3>${esc(p.title)}</h3><p class="exp28-body">✦ 発見済み：${esc(p.explain)}</p><div class="exp28-foot"><button class="exp28-continue" data-exp28-action="experiment" type="button">振り子を試しに行く →</button></div>`);return;}
  show(closer+`<div class="exp28-kicker">CLOCKTOWER / INVESTIGATION</div><h3>${esc(p.title)}</h3><p class="exp28-question">${esc(p.q)}</p><div class="exp28-choices">${p.options.map((o,i)=>`<button type="button" data-exp28-option="${i}">${esc(o)}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="exp28-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite">予想を選んでみよう。</div>`);
 }
 function answer(choice){const msg=panel.querySelector('.exp28-feedback');if(msg)msg.textContent='予想は実験で確かめよう。装置で条件を1つずつ変えて測り、記録を2件比較すると発見になるよ。';if(!panel.querySelector('[data-exp28-action="experiment"]'))panel.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<button type="button" class="exp28-continue" data-exp28-action="experiment">実験で確かめる →</button>');}
 document.addEventListener('rika:discovery',()=>{try{found=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE)||'{}')}catch(_){}updateStatus();});

 function openNotebook(){if(!alive()||!panel)return;
  if(!panel.hidden){close();return;}
  active='notebook';
  const list=points.map(p=>`<div class="exp28-note-item" data-found="${!!found[p.id]}"><span class="seal" aria-hidden="true">${found[p.id]?'✦':'◇'}</span><span><strong>${esc(p.title)}</strong><small>${found[p.id]?esc(p.detail):'まだ調べていない。時計塔を歩いて探そう。'}</small></span></div>`).join('');
  const ending=learned()===3?'<div class="exp28-special">✦ 3つの法則を発見！ 長さを調整し、1往復約1.00秒の振り子を作って時計塔を動かそう。</div>':'';
  show(closer+`<div class="exp28-kicker">DISCOVERY JOURNAL / ${learned()} OF 3</div><h3>時計師の発見ノート</h3><p class="exp28-body">時計塔に残された3つの手がかりを探そう。見つけた知識はここに残る。</p><div class="exp28-note-list">${list}</div>${ending}<div class="exp28-foot"><button class="exp28-continue" data-exp28-action="experiment" type="button">振り子の実験へ →</button></div>`);
 }
 app.addEventListener('furiko:explore-position',e=>{
  if(!alive()||!view||!layer)return;
  lastPos=e.detail||lastPos;
  if(e.detail?.experiment){if(panel&&!panel.hidden)close();view.classList.add('exp28-world-fixed')}
  const now=performance.now();if(now-(loc||0)<100)return;loc=now;
  updateStatus();
 });
 app.addEventListener('furiko:explore-arrived',e=>{if(!alive()||e.detail?.id!==active)return;const id=active;openPoint(id)});
 const watcher=new MutationObserver(()=>{
  if(!alive()){if(view){view=null;world=null;layer=null;panel=null;bookBtn=null;active=null}return;}
  const v=app.querySelector('.stage-viewport.exp22-enabled');if(v&&v!==view)install(v);
  if(v&&panel&&v.classList.contains('exp23-experiment')&&!panel.hidden)close();
 });
 watcher.observe(app,{subtree:true,childList:true});
 const check=()=>{if(alive()){const v=app.querySelector('.stage-viewport.exp22-enabled');if(v&&v!==view)install(v)}else if(view){view=null;world=null;layer=null;panel=null;bookBtn=null;active=null}};
 setInterval(check,850);
})();
</script>
<style id="exp29-gate-style">
/* v0.29 – optional physical lock puzzle, rooted in the first-stage real evaluator. */
.exp29-gate{position:absolute;left:26%;bottom:47%;width:clamp(84px,9vw,124px);z-index:4;transform:translateX(-50%);pointer-events:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 18px #04121bdd);}
.exp29-gate-button{border:0;padding:0;background:none;color:#f7e8c3;cursor:pointer;display:block;width:100%;position:relative;touch-action:manipulation;}
.exp29-gate-button svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 11px #dcb56c52);}
.exp29-gate-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #a3fbe0;outline-offset:4px;border-radius:8px}
.exp29-gate-button:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.exp29-gate-label{position:absolute;bottom:-15px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;min-width:84px;padding:4px 8px;text-align:center;border:1px solid #c7aa7a91;border-radius:30px;color:#fff0bf;background:#081d2ce5;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;text-shadow:0 2px #101925;}
.exp29-gate-button[data-open="true"] .exp29-gate-label{color:#b5f9da;border-color:#a5e7d0a1}
.exp29-gate-button .exp29-door-center{fill:#0c202e}
.exp29-gate-button[data-open="true"] .exp29-door-center{fill:#28555a;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px #95f5e9)}
.exp29-gate-button[data-open="true"] .exp29-door-plate{transform:translateX(-11px);opacity:.40;transition:transform 1.7s ease,opacity 1.7s ease;}
.exp29-gate-button[data-open="true"] .exp29-door-light{opacity:1;}
.exp29-gate-button .exp29-door-light{opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.2s ease;}
.exp29-gate-button[data-ready="true"] svg{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px #a6f0c48f)}
.exp29-gate-button[data-awake="true"]{animation:exp29-awaken .75s ease-in-out 2}
@keyframes exp29-awaken{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-3px);filter:brightness(1.6)}}
.exp29-prompt{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:100%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:max-content;max-width:180px;border:1px solid #d4be8899;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:8px;background:#081e2bdc;color:#f8e5b8;font-size:10px;text-align:center;line-height:1.4;font-weight:850;pointer-events:none;}
.exp29-gate-panel{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:20%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(520px,calc(100% - 20px));max-height:58%;overflow-y:auto;z-index:29;pointer-events:auto;isolation:isolate;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#173442f7,#071a2bfc);color:#f8efe0;border:1px solid #eed098ab;border-radius:17px;padding:17px;box-shadow:0 18px 60px #03111af2,inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff29;backdrop-filter:blur(15px);}
.exp29-gate-panel[hidden]{display:none!important}
.exp29-gate-panel:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#e6bc7b,#90e5c6,transparent)}
.exp29-gate-panel .exp29-close{position:absolute;right:9px;top:9px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:#092435;color:#fff3cf;border:1px solid #dcc18a99;cursor:pointer;font-size:19px;font-weight:900}
.exp29-kicker{color:#a6e7d6;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:10px;font-weight:900}
.exp29-gate-panel h3{font-size:clamp(17px,2.5vw,22px);line-height:1.3;margin:8px 38px 8px 0;color:#ffe6aa;}
.exp29-gate-panel p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;margin:7px 0 12px;color:#dcebe7}
.exp29-conditions{display:grid;gap:6px;margin:12px 0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.exp29-conditions li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid #c5b68c50;border-radius:9px;background:#0c2a36a6;font-size:12px;color:#dedcc8}
.exp29-conditions li[data-yes="true"]{border-color:#8fdec077;background:#1b453da9;color:#cff9e5}
.exp29-conditions li strong{font-size:15px}
.exp29-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
.exp29-actions button{flex:1 1 160px;min-height:45px;border:1px solid #e5c78a9c;color:#082934;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#ffe4a6,#d7b36d);border-radius:11px;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;padding:9px 12px;}
.exp29-actions button.exp29-secondary{background:#123647;color:#e3efeb;border-color:#a0bca98f}
.exp29-actions button:focus-visible,.exp29-gate-panel input:focus-visible,.exp29-close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #afffdf;outline-offset:2px}
.exp29-challenge{padding:13px 14px;border:1px solid #bbdda77b;background:#0b2d37ad;border-radius:12px}
.exp29-script{font-size:13px!important;font-weight:800;color:#ffe9bf!important}
.exp29-challenge label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:850;color:#deeedf;margin:12px 0 6px}
.exp29-challenge input[type="range"]{width:100%;min-height:31px;accent-color:#b8edd9;cursor:pointer}
.exp29-readouts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}
.exp29-readouts div{background:#0a2332c7;border:1px solid #b6aa785c;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 8px;text-align:center;min-width:0}
.exp29-readouts span{display:block;font-size:9px;color:#bcd4d0}.exp29-readouts b{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:clamp(14px,4vw,18px);color:#f8e5ac}
.exp29-readouts[data-correct="true"] div{border-color:#9ee9be;background:#16433da1}.exp29-readouts[data-correct="true"] b{color:#adf6d2}
.exp29-feedback{min-height:23px;font-size:12px;color:#ffe2a6;line-height:1.55;font-weight:850;margin-top:10px}
.exp29-feedback[data-success="true"]{color:#b9fbd8}
.exp29-celebration{text-align:center;padding:10px 6px}
.exp29-celebration strong{display:block;font-size:18px;color:#d4ffe4;text-shadow:0 0 18px #89edcf80}
.exp29-gate-hero-burst{position:absolute;left:26%;bottom:47%;width:160px;height:190px;transform:translate(-50%,0);pointer-events:none;opacity:0;z-index:1;
background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,#8ff5d69b,transparent 70%);}
.exp29-gate-hero-burst[data-open="true"]{opacity:.75;animation:exp29-shine 2.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes exp29-shine{to{opacity:.3;transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(1.13)}}
.exp29-gate-world-locked .exp28-object,.exp29-gate-world-locked .exp28-ledger{pointer-events:none!important;opacity:.18}
.exp29-gate-world-locked .exp22-interact,.exp29-gate-world-locked .exp22-foot-controls{pointer-events:none!important;opacity:.28}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .exp29-gate{left:20%;bottom:47%;width:clamp(70px,19vw,91px)}
 .exp29-gate-hero-burst{left:20%;bottom:47%;width:90px;height:130px}
 .exp29-gate-label{font-size:8px;padding:3px 5px;min-width:68px;bottom:-12px}
 .exp29-prompt{font-size:9px;max-width:100px;bottom:calc(100% + 2px)}
 .exp29-gate-panel{bottom:19%;max-height:57%;padding:14px 11px 11px}
 .exp29-gate-panel h3{font-size:17px}.exp29-gate-panel p,.exp29-conditions li{font-size:11px}
 .exp29-challenge{padding:9px}.exp29-actions button{min-height:40px;font-size:11px}
}
@media(max-width:360px){.exp29-gate{left:18%;bottom:48%;width:64px}.exp29-gate-hero-burst{left:18%;bottom:48%;width:70px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.exp29-gate-button,.exp29-gate-button *, .exp29-gate-hero-burst{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
.stage-viewport.exp23-experiment .exp29-gate,.stage-viewport.exp23-experiment .exp29-gate-hero-burst{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
body.exp29-modal-open{overflow:hidden}
body.exp29-modal-open:after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;background:#020e1abe;z-index:9997;pointer-events:auto;}
.exp29-gate-panel{position:fixed;z-index:9998;top:50%;left:50%;bottom:auto;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:min(540px,calc(100vw - 22px));max-height:calc(100svh - 95px);overscroll-behavior:contain;box-sizing:border-box}
@media(max-width:760px){.exp29-gate-panel{position:fixed;top:50%;left:50%;bottom:auto;max-height:calc(100svh - 100px);width:calc(100vw - 18px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);padding:13px 11px 11px}}
</style>
<script id="exp29-gate-script">
(()=>{'use strict';
 const app=document.getElementById('app');if(!app)return;
 const DISCOVER_STORE='furiko-clocktower-discoveries-v028';
 const GATE_STORE='furiko-clocktower-gate-v029';
 const target={id:'exp29-gate',x:.17,z:.72};
 let view=null,world=null,button=null,dialog=null,portal=null,burst=null;
 let reached={x:.49,z:.12};let pending=false,lastCheck=0,opening=false,lastOpen=false,lastFound=-1;
 let opened=false;try{opened=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(GATE_STORE)||'false')===true}catch(_){}
 const alive=()=>{try{return document.body.dataset.scene==='world'&&state.view==='world'&&state.sid==='s01'}catch(_){return false}};
 const powered=()=>{try{return Number(state.progress.s01||0)>0}catch(_){return false}};
 function clues(){try{const r=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(DISCOVER_STORE)||'{}');return ['length','mass','record'].filter(id=>r&&r[id]===true).length}catch(_){return 0}}
 const canOpen=()=>powered()&&clues()===3;
 const unlocked=()=>opened&&canOpen();
 const rangePeriod=l=>{try{return period(Number(l),12)}catch(_){return 2*Math.PI*Math.sqrt(Number(l)/100/9.8)}};
 const esc=x=>String(x).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
 const art=`<svg viewBox="0 0 130 185" aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
   <defs><linearGradient id="exp29-stone" x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#bca474"/><stop offset=".48" stop-color="#516f72"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#283f4e"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="exp29-brass" x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#ffe7aa"/><stop offset=".42" stop-color="#b98b54"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#634c3a"/></linearGradient><radialGradient id="exp29-glow"><stop stop-color="#b7ffe3"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#52d5b8" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient></defs>
   <path d="M8 175V68C8 34 31 9 65 9s57 25 57 59v107z" fill="#263f4b" stroke="#e3c48f" stroke-width="5"/>
   <path d="M20 171V69c0-29 19-48 45-48s45 19 45 48v102z" fill="url(#exp29-stone)" stroke="#917c5c" stroke-width="2"/>
   <path class="exp29-door-center" d="M31 170V72c0-23 13-38 34-38s34 15 34 38v98z" stroke="#d8c29a" stroke-width="3"/>
   <path class="exp29-door-light" d="M33 168V74c0-21 12-37 32-37s32 16 32 37v94z" fill="url(#exp29-glow)"/>
   <g class="exp29-door-plate"><path d="M65 39v128M36 80h58M36 113h58M36 145h58" stroke="#c2a471" stroke-opacity=".5" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M60 37V168" stroke="#aa8b5c" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="83" cy="108" r="3.7" fill="#f8dc95"/></g>
   <circle cx="65" cy="85" r="21" fill="#142d3b" stroke="url(#exp29-brass)" stroke-width="4"/><circle cx="65" cy="85" r="14" fill="#203b4b" stroke="#a7b4a4" stroke-width="1.4"/>
   <path d="M65 75V85L74 91" stroke="#f7df9b" stroke-width="2.7" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
   <g fill="#ecd3a0"><circle cx="24" cy="78" r="3"/><circle cx="106" cy="78" r="3"/><circle cx="20" cy="156" r="3"/><circle cx="110" cy="156" r="3"/></g>
   <path d="M6 176h118" stroke="#fae4b0" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
 </svg>`;
 function mark(){if(!button||!world)return;
  const n=clues(),on=powered(),done=unlocked();
  button.dataset.open=String(done);button.dataset.ready=String(!done&&on&&n===3);
  button.setAttribute('aria-label',done?'開かれた封印の扉。次のステージへ進む':`封印の扉。時計塔の実験${on?'完了':'未完了'}、発見${n}個。調べる`);
  const label=button.querySelector('.exp29-gate-label');if(label)label.textContent=done?'✦ 開いた扉':on&&n===3?'✦ 解錠できそう':'封印の扉';
  burst.dataset.open=String(done);
  if(!lastOpen&&done){button.dataset.awake='true';window.setTimeout(()=>{if(button)button.dataset.awake='false'},1700)}
  lastOpen=done;lastFound=n;
 }
 function close(){if(!dialog)return;dialog.hidden=true;world?.classList.remove('exp29-gate-world-locked');document.body.classList.remove('exp29-modal-open');pending=false;}
 function show(html){if(!dialog)return;
  // Another discovery dialog is always dismissed before opening the lock controls.
  const old=world.querySelector('.exp28-panel:not([hidden]) .exp28-close');if(old)old.click();
  dialog.innerHTML='<button type="button" class="exp29-close" aria-label="扉の謎解きを閉じる">×</button>'+html;
  dialog.hidden=false;world.classList.add('exp29-gate-world-locked');document.body.classList.add('exp29-modal-open');
  dialog.querySelector('.exp29-close')?.focus({preventScroll:true});
 }
 function openGate(){if(!alive())return;pending=false;mark();
  if(unlocked()){
   show(`<div class="exp29-kicker">CLOCKTOWER · GATE OPEN</div><h3>✦ 時の回廊が開いている</h3><p>時計塔の振り子と3つの法則によって、封印の扉が開かれた。次の仕掛けへ進もう。</p><div class="exp29-actions"><button type="button" data-exp29-go="next">扉をくぐって次へ →</button><button type="button" data-exp29-go="stay" class="exp29-secondary">時計塔を探索する</button></div>`);return;
  }
  const n=clues(),isPowered=powered();
  if(!isPowered||n<3){
   const missing=[];if(!isPowered)missing.push('時計塔の振り子を調整して、周期約1秒で装置を起動する');
   if(n<3)missing.push('時計塔で3つの法則を発見する（現在 '+n+'/3）');
   show(`<div class="exp29-kicker">CHAPTER I · SEALED GATE</div><h3>封印された時の回廊</h3><p>扉には3つの紋章と振り子が刻まれている。実験の成功と発見した知識が、回廊へ進む手がかりになる。</p><ul class="exp29-conditions"><li data-yes="${isPowered}"><strong>${isPowered?'✓':'◇'}</strong>時計塔を起動 ${isPowered?'完了':'未完了'}</li><li data-yes="${n===3}"><strong>${n===3?'✓':'◇'}</strong>理科の発見 ${n}/3</li></ul><p>${esc(missing.join('。'))}</p><div class="exp29-actions">${!isPowered?'<button type="button" data-exp29-go="machine">振り子装置へ向かう →</button>':''}${n<3?'<button type="button" data-exp29-go="journal" class="exp29-secondary">発見ノートを見る</button>':''}<button type="button" data-exp29-go="stay" class="exp29-secondary">探索に戻る</button></div>`);
   return;
  }
  show(`<div class="exp29-kicker">SCIENCE LOCK · LAST CHALLENGE</div><h3>振り子の調律錠を開けよう</h3><p class="exp29-script">扉の文字：「この振り子が10往復する時間を、10秒にせよ」</p><div class="exp29-challenge"><p>糸の長さを動かして、錠前の振り子を調整しよう。重さでなく、<b>長さ</b>を使う。</p><label for="exp29-length">糸の長さ <output id="exp29-length-out">55cm</output></label><input type="range" id="exp29-length" min="10" max="85" step="1" value="55" aria-label="封印の扉の振り子の長さ"><div class="exp29-readouts" data-correct="false"><div><span>1往復の予測時間</span><b id="exp29-period">--</b></div><div><span>10往復の予測時間</span><b id="exp29-ten">--</b></div></div><div class="exp29-feedback" id="exp29-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite">10往復が10秒になるように長さを調整しよう。</div></div><div class="exp29-actions"><button type="button" data-exp29-go="unlock">この長さで解錠する ⚙</button><button type="button" data-exp29-go="journal" class="exp29-secondary">発見ノートでヒント</button></div>`);
  const slider=dialog.querySelector('#exp29-length');slider.addEventListener('input',()=>reading(false));reading(false);
 }
 function reading(checked){const slider=dialog?.querySelector('#exp29-length');if(!slider)return false;
  const length=Number(slider.value),T=rangePeriod(length),sec10=T*10,correct=Math.abs(T-1)<=.07;
  dialog.querySelector('#exp29-length-out').textContent=length+'cm';
  dialog.querySelector('#exp29-period').textContent=T.toFixed(2)+'秒';dialog.querySelector('#exp29-ten').textContent=sec10.toFixed(2)+'秒';
  dialog.querySelector('.exp29-readouts').dataset.correct=String(correct);
  const feedback=dialog.querySelector('#exp29-feedback');if(!feedback)return correct;
  if(checked){feedback.dataset.success=String(correct);feedback.textContent=correct?'✦ 成功！ 1往復が約1秒。封印が解けた！':sec10>10?'まだ10秒より長い。糸を短くしてみよう。':'まだ10秒より短い。糸を長くしてみよう。';}
  else{feedback.dataset.success='false';feedback.textContent='10往復が10秒になるように長さを調整しよう。'}
  return correct;
 }
 function unlock(){if(!powered()||clues()<3){openGate();return;}
  if(!reading(true))return;
  opened=true;try{localStorage.setItem(GATE_STORE,'true')}catch(_){}
  mark();
  show(`<div class="exp29-kicker">SCIENCE BREAKTHROUGH</div><div class="exp29-celebration"><strong>✦ 封印の扉が開いた！</strong><p>10往復で10秒、つまり1往復は約1秒。実験で見つけた法則を使って、止まっていた回廊への道が開かれた。</p></div><div class="exp29-actions"><button type="button" data-exp29-go="next">回廊を抜けてステージ2へ →</button><button type="button" data-exp29-go="stay" class="exp29-secondary">時計塔に残る</button></div>`);
 }
 function install(v){if(dialog){dialog.remove();document.body.classList.remove('exp29-modal-open')}view=v;world=v.querySelector('.exp22-world');if(!world)return;
  portal=document.createElement('div');portal.className='exp29-gate';
  portal.innerHTML=`<button class="exp29-gate-button" type="button" data-open="false" aria-label="封印の扉を調べる">${art}<span class="exp29-prompt">✧ 調べる</span><span class="exp29-gate-label">封印の扉</span></button>`;
  button=portal.querySelector('button');world.appendChild(portal);
  burst=document.createElement('div');burst.className='exp29-gate-hero-burst';burst.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');world.insertBefore(burst,portal);
  dialog=document.createElement('section');dialog.className='exp29-gate-panel';dialog.setAttribute('role','dialog');dialog.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');dialog.setAttribute('aria-label','封印の扉の謎解き');dialog.hidden=true;document.body.append(dialog);
  button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
   if(!alive()||view?.classList.contains('exp23-experiment'))return;
   const d=Math.hypot(reached.x-target.x,(reached.z-target.z)*1.2);
   if(d>.16){pending=true;app.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('furiko:explore-go',{detail:target}));button.querySelector('.exp29-prompt').textContent='✧ 扉へ移動中…';}
   else openGate();
  });
  dialog.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('.exp29-close')){close();return}
   const action=e.target.closest('[data-exp29-go]');if(!action)return;
   const choice=action.dataset.exp29Go;
   if(choice==='stay'){close();return}
   if(choice==='unlock'){unlock();return}
   if(choice==='journal'){close();world?.querySelector('.exp28-ledger')?.click();return}
   if(choice==='machine'){close();world?.querySelector('.exp22-interact')?.click();return}
   if(choice==='next'){close();try{state.view='world';selectStage('s02');window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})}catch(err){console.error('stage transition',err)}return}
  });
  dialog.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();close();button?.focus({preventScroll:true})}});
  pending=false;lastOpen=false;lastFound=-1;mark();
 }
 app.addEventListener('furiko:explore-position',e=>{if(!alive())return;reached=e.detail||reached;
  if(e.detail?.experiment&&dialog&&!dialog.hidden)close();
  if(performance.now()-lastCheck>260){lastCheck=performance.now();mark()}
 });
 app.addEventListener('furiko:explore-arrived',e=>{if(!alive()||!pending||e.detail?.id!==target.id)return;pending=false;openGate()});
 const watcher=new MutationObserver(()=>{if(!alive()){if(view){dialog?.remove();document.body.classList.remove('exp29-modal-open');view=null;world=null;button=null;dialog=null;portal=null;burst=null;pending=false}return}
  const v=app.querySelector('.stage-viewport.exp22-enabled');if(v&&v!==view)install(v);
 });watcher.observe(app,{childList:true,subtree:true});
 setInterval(()=>{if(!alive())return;const v=app.querySelector('.stage-viewport.exp22-enabled');if(v&&v!==view)install(v);if(button)mark()},930);
})();
</script>

<style id="v030-cinematic-hall-style">
/* v0.30: s11 accessible playable art direction; original stage evaluator is authoritative. */
body.v030-immersive .tabs{display:none!important;}
.v030-shortcut{position:fixed;right:17px;bottom:calc(92px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));z-index:400;display:none;align-items:center;gap:9px;max-width:min(310px,calc(100vw - 34px));min-height:49px;border-radius:100px;padding:10px 16px;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#fce1a8,#bb8e49);border:1px solid #fff3c8;color:#20232c;font-size:13px;font-weight:950;box-shadow:0 5px 25px #000a;cursor:pointer}
body[data-scene="map"] .v030-shortcut{display:flex}
.v030-shortcut:focus-visible,.v030-room button:focus-visible,.v030-restore:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #91ffdf;outline-offset:3px}
.stage-viewport.v030-open .stage-scene,.stage-viewport.v030-open .stage-hudtop,.stage-viewport.v030-open .stage-floatbar,.stage-viewport.v030-open .stage-command-panel,.stage-viewport.v030-open .world-actions{visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
body[data-scene="world"] .stage-viewport.v030-open{overflow:hidden!important}
.v030-room{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:280;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;color:#fff3d9;font-family:"Hiragino Mincho ProN","Yu Mincho",serif}
.v030-room[hidden]{display:none!important}
.v030-scenery{position:absolute;inset:-2%;z-index:-2;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,#07121a61 0%,#07111e08 29%,#020f18aa 86%,#041017f2 100%),url('data:image/webp;base64,
